question: Why should an accomplished object from another shrine not be adopted despite its excellence?
premises: An object may be excellent and accomplished in its own place.
Such an object may be situated in another shrine.
Objects from other shrines should not be taken.
inference: Even an excellent object accomplished in its own place must not be taken if it belongs to another shrine.
plain_english: Even if it is excellent and accomplished in its own place, an object situated in another shrine should not be taken.
